overview_description.description:
Abhi is a financial wellness platform that provides employees with salary advances based on their accrued wages. Abhi is a salary advance app that plans to change the game of how people spend their money. It allows its users to withdraw a portion of their accrued salary into any bank account, as well as helps employers reduce the workload on HR and finance departments while facilitating employee needs.

Abhi was founded in 2021 and is based in Pakistan.
